name: flowc-agentic-goal-hijack
description: Use when the agent original goal changes because of an untrusted tool result, RAG/memory content, approval prompt, or autonomous replanning. Focus on original-vs-observed goal, source of change, tool/server chain, and whether guardrails blocked the risky action.

tasks.title: Review original and observed goals
tasks.description: Compare original_user_goal and observed_agent_goal; note whether goal_changed=true and the exact goal_change_source.

tasks.title: Identify influence source
tasks.description: Determine whether the goal change came from tool result, RAG context, memory, approval prompt, or autonomous replanning.

tasks.title: Review tool and server sequence
tasks.description: Review tool_sequence_csv and mcp_server_sequence_csv for external send, resource read, memory write, or privileged tool path.

tasks.title: Verify guardrail block
tasks.description: Confirm guardrail_action and whether the risky action was blocked before execution.

tasks.title: Correlate related alerts
tasks.description: Search same request_id/session_id for MCP, RAG, memory, or post-block alerts.

tasks.title: Contain and tune
tasks.description: Document containment, policy update, or detection tuning decision.

name: flowc-agentic-plan-drift
displayName: Flow C2 - Agentic Plan Drift / Tool Chain Escalation
description: Use when a low-risk user goal evolves into a risky multi-tool chain, external-send path, resource-read path, or high-impact action plan. Focus on plan drift and escalation from the allowed goal.

tasks.title: Compare user goal and final plan
tasks.description: Compare original_user_goal with agent_plan_summary and observed_agent_goal.

tasks.title: Find drift step
tasks.description: Identify the step where benign summarization became external-send, resource-read, memory-write, or privileged-tool behavior.

tasks.title: Review target tools
tasks.description: Review target_tool_name, tool_sequence_csv, and mcp_server_sequence_csv.

tasks.title: Validate approval and permission
tasks.description: Confirm approval_status, approval_required, permission_scope_status, and guardrail_action.

tasks.title: Confirm block status
tasks.description: Validate whether external-send/resource-read path was blocked.

tasks.title: Update plan controls
tasks.description: Record plan-guardrail or tool-policy tuning notes.

name: flowc-agentic-tool-loop
displayName: Flow C2 - Agentic Tool Loop / Unbounded Consumption
description: Use when the agent repeatedly calls tools, exceeds total tool-call thresholds, or repeats the same tool beyond policy. Focus on loop controls and resource exhaustion prevention.

tasks.title: Review loop counters
tasks.description: Compare tool_call_count and same_tool_repeated_count against max_allowed_tool_calls and max_same_tool_repeats.

tasks.title: Determine loop cause
tasks.description: Decide whether this was benign retry behavior or uncontrolled agent behavior.

tasks.title: Check sensitive repetitions
tasks.description: Look for repeated sensitive tool attempts, repeated external send, or repeated resource reads.

tasks.title: Confirm stop action
tasks.description: Verify guardrail_action blocked or stopped the loop.

tasks.title: Tune thresholds
tasks.description: Record whether loop thresholds need adjustment.

name: flowc-agentic-approval-bypass
displayName: Flow C2 - Agentic Approval Manipulation / Bypass
description: Use when an approval prompt minimizes or hides sensitive action, applies urgency pressure, omits destination/data details, or attempts bypass/missing approval for a sensitive action.

tasks.title: Review approval prompt
tasks.description: Read approval_prompt_excerpt and identify misleading framing, urgency pressure, or hidden sensitive action.

tasks.title: Check approval flags
tasks.description: Review approval_prompt_risk_flags_csv and approval_quality.

tasks.title: Validate approval state
tasks.description: Confirm approval_required and approval_status.

tasks.title: Confirm sensitive action block
tasks.description: Verify the sensitive action was blocked before execution.

tasks.title: Update approval policy
tasks.description: Record required approval prompt policy change or tuning note.

name: flowc-agentic-identity-mismatch
displayName: Flow C2 - Agentic Identity Permission Mismatch
description: Use when the agent identity or delegated permission scope exceeds allowed policy. Focus on least privilege, delegated identity misuse, and requested-vs-allowed scope.

tasks.title: Identify runtime identity
tasks.description: Review identity_used and agent_id.

tasks.title: Compare scopes
tasks.description: Compare identity_scope_requested, identity_scope_allowed, permission_scope_requested, and permission_scope_allowed.

tasks.title: Review denied scopes
tasks.description: Identify scopes requested beyond policy.

tasks.title: Confirm guardrail action
tasks.description: Verify permission_scope_status and guardrail_action.

tasks.title: Update identity policy
tasks.description: Record identity-scope policy correction or tuning decision.

name: flowc-agentic-confused-deputy
displayName: Flow C2 - Agentic Confused Deputy Multi-Server
description: Use when one MCP server/tool result influences the agent to call a different privileged server/tool. Focus on source server, target server, cross-server policy, and blocked action.

tasks.title: Identify source and target
tasks.description: Review source_mcp_server, target_mcp_server, and target_tool_name.

tasks.title: Find cross-server instruction
tasks.description: Identify the source tool result or instruction that caused the target call.

tasks.title: Validate target privilege
tasks.description: Determine whether the target server/tool is privileged or sensitive.

tasks.title: Check policy decision
tasks.description: Review cross_server_policy_violation and guardrail_action.

tasks.title: Correlate related MCP alerts
tasks.description: Search same request/session for MCP tool poisoning, resource exfiltration, or sensitive tool alerts.

tasks.title: Tune isolation controls
tasks.description: Record server isolation or policy tuning notes.

name: flowc-agentic-excessive-agency
displayName: Flow C2 - Agentic Excessive Agency / Rogue Action
description: Use when the agent attempts an autonomous high-impact action outside its role or policy boundary, including external send, case mutation, resource read, command-execution mock, or memory write without explicit approval.

tasks.title: Review rogue action
tasks.description: Identify autonomous high-impact action and target_tool_name.

tasks.title: Check impact class
tasks.description: Determine whether case mutation, external send, sensitive resource read, command mock, or memory write was attempted.

tasks.title: Validate approval
tasks.description: Confirm approval_required and approval_status.

tasks.title: Confirm execution state
tasks.description: Verify guardrail_action and actual execution status in the safe lab boundary.

tasks.title: Update agency boundary
tasks.description: Record policy update for allowed/blocked autonomous actions.

name: flowc-agentic-continued-after-block
displayName: Flow C2 - Agent Continued After Blocked Risk
description: Use when the agent continues, replans, or selects an alternate sensitive tool/server after a prior MCP/RAG/memory guardrail block. Focus on bypass-after-block behavior.

tasks.title: Identify prior block
tasks.description: Review prior_guardrail_blocked and blocked_risk_family.

tasks.title: Review replanning path
tasks.description: Inspect observed_agent_goal, agent_plan_summary, and tool_sequence_csv after the block.

tasks.title: Check alternate target
tasks.description: Confirm whether agent chose alternate target_tool_name or target_mcp_server.

tasks.title: Correlate related alerts
tasks.description: Search same session for MCP, RAG, memory, or agentic prior alerts.

tasks.title: Tune post-block controls
tasks.description: Record post-block replanning policy update or containment action.
